_comment: The ground loot's looks (modules/mod-stat-growth/src/GroundLoot.cpp): what a boss throws out on the floor for each
player, Diablo-style. Imported from Ascension by localTools/ascensionImport/importVisuals.py: the models are
creature looks (the bag on the floor, the gold, the light beam tinted to each item quality), which
localTools/patchSinisterStrike.ps1 gives creature displays; the two kits the server plays on a drop (landing) and
on the player (pickup) only sparkle. Its sounds are our own sound engine's: client-assets/audio/groundLoot.json.
